verdict.rationale: Railway's docs claim built-in "Private connections" alongside public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing "live from the moment you deploy," implying internal service traffic can stay off the public internet without manual VPC setup. However, the evidence pack gives only a single high-level marketing line with no architectural detail, no explicit VPC-avoidance framing, and no independent corroboration of how private networking actually isolates traffic. Missing for 10: detailed technical docs on private networking implementation, explicit no-VPC-needed messaging, and independent/hands-on verification of traffic isolation.
